items.problem: "Every request" leaves a `request` log line, and that includes the routes that modules export (e.g. `POST /admin/<operation>`, `GET /account/deletion`, `POST /iap/notify/<store>`, `GET /update/files/<sha256>`, `GET /realtime`), as the test at routing.md:289 does. But no defining document sets the `request` log fields for a route: common field `request` is defined only as a contract request name or an admin operation name (`skills/server-core/SKILL.md:212`), and `error_code`, `client_version` and `platform` (`logging.md:90`) have no value for an HTTP-status route response or for a WebSocket route that took over the connection (handler returns `null`, routing.md:58). Implementations can differ in whether they write the line and in its field values. This existed before the diff (the "every request" sentence was already there)
